title: Edge of the Trench
message: Descended into the Starfall Trench, where Shizuki quietly watched glowing stars drift through the depths before uncovering {reward} Star Candies from ancient star debris

title: Falling Starlight
message: wandered through the Starfall Trench as drifting starlight slowly settled upon the ancient seabed, revealing {reward} Star Candies hidden beneath shimmering Fae ruins~

title: The Silent Archway
message: wandered beneath a weathered Fae archway in the Starfall Trench, where drifting starlight illuminated {reward} Star Candies resting undisturbed for ages~

title: Forgotten Star Collector
message: discovered a forgotten Fae Star Collector deep within the Starfall Trench, where centuries of drifting starlight had gathered into {reward} Star Candies~

title: Elven Observatory
message: explored an ancient Elven Observatory overlooking the Starfall Trench, where moon carved lenses still gathered drifting starlight around {reward} Star Candies left untouched for centuries~

title: Moonstone Runes
message: followed a trail of glowing Moonstone Runes through the Starfall Trench, where ancient Elven inscriptions led you to {reward} Star Candies hidden beneath weathered stone~

title: Forgotten Camp
message: stumbled upon a small camp tucked beneath ancient Elven stonework, where a note reading 'Definitely not mine. - Shizuki' rested beside {reward} Star Candies left behind~

title: Moonstone Crossing
message: crossed an elegant Moonstone bridge suspended above the Starfall Trench, where shimmering starlight revealed {reward} Star Candies nestled between centuries old Elven carvings~

title: Berry Thief
message: caught a mischievous Moon Sprite dragging away Shizuki's berry pouch, but it dropped {reward} Star Candies while making its escape~

title: The Stubborn Star
message: noticed a tiny falling star stubbornly following you through the Starfall Trench before it finally landed with a cheerful *plink*, revealing {reward} Star Candies hidden beneath the sand~

title: Star Snail
message: helped a Star Snail flip back onto its tiny feet, and it happily pointed you toward {reward} Star Candies hidden beneath a glowing Moonstone pebble~

title: Moon Crab Treasure
message: challenged a grumpy Moon Crab guarding its 'treasure,' only to discover it had proudly collected {reward} Star Candies and a very ordinary rock~

title: The Moon Crab Tax
message: was stopped by a serious Moon Crab demanding one shiny pebble as a 'crossing fee,' then discovered it had been sitting on {reward} Star Candies the entire time~

title: Almost Caught Her
message: heard laughter echo through the trench just before spotting Shizuki disappear around a Moonstone pillar, leaving behind {reward} Star Candies and a tiny note that simply read, 'Too slow!'~

title: Still Warm
message: followed the comforting scent of fresh berry tea to a tiny campsite, but Shizuki had already wandered off, leaving a warm mug beside {reward} Star Candies and a note saying, 'Be back... probably!~'

title: Fresh Sketch
message: discovered a beautifully sketched map of an ancient Elven observatory. In the corner, someone had scribbled, 'Needs more berries.' Following the map led you to {reward} Star Candies~

title: The Shortcut
message: followed one of Shizuki's notes promising, 'Shortcut this way!~' After wandering in a complete circle, you somehow stumbled upon {reward} Star Candies hidden beneath a Moonstone arch anyway~
